name: F. Inverse design
description: The Optimization Studio searches the phases of an array for the strongest focus, compares the candidates and promotes the best one into the design.
expected: the best candidate's objective exceeds the initial design's
limitations: the search is local to the algorithm and bounds of the saved problem
the promoted design is evaluated with the analytical model only

story.problem: Find a design that meets a goal without trying every variant by hand.
story.configure: Design variables (the element phases), the objective (pressure at the focus) and the algorithm, saved in the project.
story.calculate: Candidate designs, each evaluated with the acoustic model, searched by the problem's algorithm.
story.meaning: The best candidate is the design that focuses most strongly at the target within the variables' bounds.
story.inspect: The candidates table (objective of each candidate, the best marked), the progress plot, the promoted design revision.
story.value: The search is recorded and repeatable; the best design is applied with one undoable command and marked unvalidated until checked.
story.assumptions: The objective is evaluated with the analytical free-field model; the algorithm and its seed are those of the saved problem.
